name: Boat-tailed Grackle
desc: Boat-tailed Grackle (Quiscalus major): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1,866 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The boat-tailed grackle is a passerine bird of the family Icteridae found as a permanent resident on the coasts of the Southeastern and Mid-Atlantic United States.
